_readme: Written by the bot's main.py after each daily run and pushed to this repo. Delete this _readme key once the real writer is in place -- it's just documentation for now. free_signal / vip_signal_count should come from the SAME picks main.py already computes (high_confidence + speculative lists) -- the free one is whichever single pick you choose to expose publicly (e.g. the lowest-EV qualifying pick, so the strongest ones stay VIP-only), the rest count toward vip_signal_count. On a day with zero qualifying picks, set free_signal to null and vip_signal_count to 0 -- the page shows the honest 'no signal today' state instead of stale data.
